note: Facts labelled observed are read from the blob at the cited offset; the boot-media order and crypto list are from A733 User Manual V1.00 section 3.1 and corroborate the dispatcher.

identity.observed: ns-brom version responder at 0x1a2c8; confirmed on the board (evidence/ddr-20261015-223537 FEL version line)

fel_command_table.source: ns-brom dispatcher at 0x19f40; whitelist table at 0x21370
fel_command_table.note: 16-byte request header; first halfword selects the command

commands.name: FEL_UPLOAD
commands.action: read device memory to host, window-checked

commands.name: FEL_DOWNLOAD
commands.action: write host data to device memory, window-checked

address_whitelist.note: FIXS+HS+NS BROM and SRAM A1 window

boot_media_order.source: A733 User Manual V1.00 section 3.1.3; dispatcher at 0xa00
boot_media_order.mode_select: SYSCTRL BOOT_MODE bit 0: 0 = GPADC select, 1 = eFuse select

secure_boot.source: A733 User Manual V1.00 section 3.1; SID read at 0x2a0c (0x030060a0)
secure_boot.note: The published dumps contain the normal (non-monitor) BROM; the BROM Monitor (secure half) is not in these blobs.

progress_record.note: software progress halfword written at 0xa8/0xc4 and by helper 0xd14

boot_input.note: FEL pad; four low samples select FEL
